steps: Dry-roast the moong dal for five minutes, to a nutty smell, and rinse it.
Rinse the rice and dry it. Wet rice will not toast; it steams in its own water.
Heat the ghee, brown the potatoes and lift them out.
In the same ghee fry the bay, cinnamon and cardamom, then the onion and ginger until golden.
Add the rice and dal with the turmeric and cumin and toast them five minutes, stirring.
Add boiling water at twice the volume of the grain, return the potatoes, season and add the whole chillies.
Cover and cook twenty minutes on a low heat, then let it stand ten minutes without opening it.
